facts.fact: Total media ad spend in the US is expected to hit $389.49 billion USD in 2024, according to eMarketer as cited by the page.
facts.quote: Total media ad spend](https://content-na1.emarketer.com/digital-makes-up-over-three-quarters-total-ad-spend-us) in the US is expected to hit an impressive $389.49 billion USD in 2024

facts.fact: Digital channels are expected to receive 77.7% of total US media ad spend in 2024, per the page's cited eMarketer figure.
facts.quote: with over three-quarters of that spend (77.7%) going to digital channels like mobile, desktop, and connected TV (CTV)

facts.fact: 61% of companies increased their advertising channels to reach consumers during COVID-19, according to a Harvard Business Review article cited by the page.
facts.quote: COVID-19 further accelerated this shift, with [61% of companies increasing their channels](https://hbr.org/2023/08/how-the-pandemic-changed-marketing-channels) to reach consumers.

facts.fact: The page is titled as a guide to advertising channels and was published on 2024-11-20.
The StackAdapt guide names GDPR and CCPA as privacy laws that restrict the use of certain tracking tools, which can limit brands' visibility into individual customer journeys.
facts.quote: As privacy laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) restrict the use of certain tracking tools, brands may have limited visibility into individual customer journeys

facts.fact: The guide states that traditional channels such as linear TV and OOH may require larger, upfront commitments, while digital platforms often allow easy budget adjustments and expansion.
facts.quote: traditional channels like traditional linear TV and OOH may require larger, upfront commitments
